model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of respondents' opinions on the preparedness and qualifications required to execute projects according to the Passive House standard. The chart is divided into four slices, with a legend provided on the right-hand side. The slices are labeled and colored as follows: a green slice represents 51%, a red slice represents 23%, a purple slice represents 23%, and a blue slice represents 3%. The chart does not display percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques such as explosion or offset. The segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
